tools.name: estimate_sheets
tools.description: A fast lower bound on sheets for planning and quotes: net part area divided by usable sheet area. Necessary, not sufficient: real layouts can need more sheets. Also flags parts that fit no sheet in any allowed rotation.

Request.description: What to nest. Lengths are millimetres.

common_line.description: Optional compensated common-line cutting. Its kerf replaces part spacing.

edge_spacing_mm.description: Minimum gap between parts and the sheet edge or a defect.

parts.description: Parts to place; all library parts with default settings when empty.

spacing_mm.description: Minimum gap between parts (kerf plus margin).

count.description: Available sheets of this size; absent means unlimited.

defects_mm.description: Areas that must stay clear (knots, damage, clamps), in sheet coordinates.

from_import.description:
An imported stock-outline id from Library.sheet_outlines. Omit dimensions
to use its measured size, or supply those same dimensions explicitly.

outline_mm.description:
A remnant's usable outline inside its width × height; empty means the
whole rectangle.

outline_tolerance_mm.description:
Curve-to-polygon error of an imported stock outline. Edge clearance is
increased by this error as well as the part-library curve tolerance.

tools.name: export_layout
tools.description: Write per-sheet SVG/DXF or preserving LBRN2 for a valid layout, transforming the original curves (arcs and splines stay curves). Refuses invalid layouts.

format.description: Optional svg, dxf or lbrn2; omit to use the source format default.

out_dir.description: New output directory; preserving .lbrn2 for LightBurn, SVG/DXF otherwise.

sheet_outline.description: Draw sheet boundaries (default true for LightBurn, false for SVG/DXF).

tools.name: import_parts
tools.description: Import SVG/DXF outlines or one LightBurn lbrn2/lbrn project into a part library (mm). LightBurn groups stay rigid and original artwork/settings are retained for lbrn2 export. Writes the library to a file and returns part ids, areas, bounds, layer kerf and import warnings. Use the ids in nest requests.

close_gaps_mm.description: Explicitly close gaps up to this many mm (off by default, maximum 1).

colors.description: DXF ACI numbers as strings (e.g. "7") or RGB colours (e.g. "#000000").

dxf_unit_mm.description: Millimetres per DXF unit when `$INSUNITS` is missing (default 1).

layers.description: Cut layer names; omit to prefer cut/outline/profile, then all closed contours.

library_path.description: Where to write the part library JSON; a new file under `nestbolt/` by default.

paths.description: SVG/DXF files or one .lbrn/.lbrn2 project, inside the workspace.

sheet_layers.description: Stock-outline layers offered separately from parts (defaults to SHEET).

svg_user_unit_mm.description: Millimetres per SVG user unit when a document has no absolute size (default 25.4/96).

tolerance_mm.description: Maximum distance between exact curves and nesting polygons, in mm (default 0.005).

tools.name: nest
tools.description: Nest library parts on fixed sheets with a repeatable budget (time_budget_s, at most 300). Writes job.json, layout.json, report.json and one SVG and DXF per sheet (preserving LBRN2 for LightBurn); returns the independently checked metrics. Sends progress notifications.

edge_spacing_mm.description: Minimum gap between parts and the sheet edge or a defect.

request.description: Parts (ids from `import_parts`, quantities, rotations), sheets and spacing, in mm.

seed.description: Random seed (default 0). The same inputs, budget and seed repeat exactly.

time_budget_s.description: Search budget in seconds, 1 to 300 (default 10). Also the hard real-time limit.

tools.name: validate_layout
tools.description: Check a layout file against the library parts, sheets and spacing of a request with the independent validator; returns validity, violations and material metrics.
